reason: M32 timed invocations process a concurrent batch of 32 requests. Batch-total projections must not be labeled seconds per request without division by completed request count.

required_measurement_units.decode_m32: Each M32 linear or attention invocation covers one decode step for a concurrent batch of 32 completed requests. Preserve latency per invocation and batch-total contribution, then divide the endpoint-batch contribution by 32 for seconds/request.
required_measurement_units.prefill_m3679: Each M3679 row represents one request's 3,679 fresh prefill rows unless the executed consumer explicitly batches multiple requests. Record the observed request cardinality and divide only when cardinality exceeds one.
required_measurement_units.target_verify_m384: Measure and path-bind M384 as required by the source screen, but do not charge it to the ordinary non-speculative c32 aggregate.
required_measurement_units.aggregate_rule: Compute the promotion aggregate only from request-normalized prefill and decode terms plus bound residuals. Keep the unnormalized batch total alongside it.
